entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your experience as a galley slave has given you some unique insight into the world of sailing and piracy.

Prerequisites: Profession (sailor) 1 rank, current or former galley slave

Benefit: You get a +2 circumstance bonus on Profession (sailor) made while aboard a ship with oars and rowers. When fighting on a ship, your first hit each battle gets a +2 damage bonus.
